revisions.note: Added the BrainVision samples (_eeg.eeg), markers (_eeg.vmrk) and _events.tsv of the 240 already-deposited .vhdr headers (the original snapshot kept only the headers), and the root dataset_description.json the loader uses to locate the BIDS root. Members of figshare file 57518986 (Freewill_EEG_Reaching_Grasping.zip, md5 3b7c3039c5c9fb6abf1429a830301711 = figshare computed_md5), extracted with CRC-32 checks; all 240 deposited headers equal their zip members. Three headers (sub-09 ses-02 run-0009, sub-18 ses-02 run-0006, sub-21 ses-01 run-0003) still name pre-BIDS DataFile/MarkerFile names; the release has no such files and moabb.datasets.Thapa2025 opens the BIDS-named _eeg.eeg/_eeg.vmrk instead.
